title: Lantern-Lipped Lollop Loach
statement: A shy, spaghetti-long loach who carries a single glowing bead on her lower lip and uses it to read tiny glowing messages left in the sand. She drifts in lazy loops through a drowned library of mossy teacups and barnacled books, pausing at every page to hum in soft, bubbly 'blip-blip-bloop's. The tank is lit like late-evening window light, warm amber above and deep teal below, and she is a creature who would rather linger than arrive.
